title: SLMEval: Entropy-Based Calibration for Human-Aligned Evaluation of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calibrating pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation scores using an entropy maximization framework based on small amounts of human preference data to mitigate the effect of response presentation order.
Reweighting raw evaluator scores using latent strength parameters derived from human preferences to prevent the evaluation from being artificially influenced by the length of the model outputs.
